arguments.name: start_lipsum
arguments.text: If TRUE, the first paragraph starts with Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet.

origin.details: Word choice follows Zipf weights. Sentence and paragraph lengths follow a truncated discrete normal. The result is title-cased on sentence boundaries.
origin.example: x <- stri_rand_lipsum(2, TRUE); cat(paste0("stri_rand_lipsum(2, TRUE) returns ", length(x), " paragraphs.\n"))

arguments.name: start_lipsum
arguments.text: If TRUE, the first paragraph starts with Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet.

translation.details: The word list and the Zipf weights follow stringi's R source. The draws use Python's random generator, so the paragraphs are not the same as R. start_lipsum is honored only when it is exactly True.
translation.example:
x = stri_rand_lipsum(2, True)
print(f"stri_rand_lipsum(2, True) returns {len(x)} paragraphs.")
